title: Wildheart revision: intake the revised design system and close its gaps (tokens, photos, general feminine copy)

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03 17:19Z uploaded the revised Wildheart Design System zip; 17:23Z took every recommended option (Wildheart is a general feminine website, no program copy)

detail: Intake ran per docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM-INTAKE.md: snapshot, rules, tokens and copy in docs/design-systems/wildheart/, and the design-system test now compares WILDHEART_TOKENS_CSS (light block) against the zip. Baseline froze 195 known gaps: about 80 tokens (violet moves to #6E4D96, muted text to #7D6D62, new gradients, about 50 semantic names not declared), 5 new photo exports, and 110 copy lines. Copy is NOT ported verbatim: the theme is a general website for any women-led Space, so its starter copy is written fresh per the voice guide and the program lines are retired from the baseline as rewritten. Follow-ups in order: retoken plus photos, then pages plus copy. The row closes when the baseline is empty.
